waybackify merge [flags] <base-root> <fetch-root>

Compare two cache roots without writing a merged corpus

Report the four capture-key sets after both roots pass fsck.
Output: one JSONL summary followed by key-sorted conflicts.
Equal body hashes or equal bodiless statuses agree.
Both roots must stay quiescent. Neither input is written.
Only --report is supported. No output root or writer is available.

Arguments:
  <base-root>    original cache directory
  <fetch-root>   second cache directory

Flags:
  --report       required: emit comparison JSONL without writing a corpus
  --help|-h      Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
